author: Pauldenny
body:
* **InterPro ID / label IPR001279; Metallo-B-lactamas**

* **Example sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name): 2-aminobenzoylacetyl-CoA thioesterase (P20581)**

* **I've noticed a
GO; GO:0008800; F:beta-lactamase activity; IEA:InterPro
annotation applied to a protein (P20581) not known to have this activity - it belongs to an appropriate family /  superfamily, but is very unlikely to be a beta-lactamase. There is good experimental evidence that it is a thioesterase.
How can we remove / prevent this being applied?**
title: InterPro2GO issue: incorrection assertion GO:0008800; F:beta-lactamase activity IEA

author: sarach06
body:
Hi Paul,
Thank you very much. The term was added to the family entry IPR050855, so I removed it. This will be visible in the next InterPro release 109.0.

Best regards,
Sara
